description: This is a utility module providing a centralized wrapper (apiGet) for HTTP GET requests using fetch. It handles base URL resolution, appending organization IDs, and logging, facilitating uniform API communication within the front-end project.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines and constructs the base URL for API calls, prioritizing configuration, environment variables, and finally defaulting to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a relative or absolute path, correctly handling cases with /api prefixes and full URLs.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends the organization_id query parameter to URLs if available and not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a specified URL or path, handling URL construction, authorization headers, automatic organization ID insertion, and response parsing.
